ledger.x: 4600 BCE: the Rössen culture follows the Linear Pottery in central Europe.
4300 BCE: the Rössen ends and its eastern and southern country is left to post-Rössen groups.
4300 BCE: the Rössen gives way to the Michelsberg culture on the Rhine.

certainty.note: A prehistoric culture known from its sites; the extent is the researcher's reading of country names, with no frontier on the page.
